# Migrated review

Money moves from floats to integer cents across the order model and its two callers.
The conversion itself is right; the migration backfill and one serializer are not.

## Provenance

This document is a mechanical translation of a legacy review artifact's machine
block. Nothing in it was re-derived from the current code: every finding below is
the legacy reviewer's claim, carried across so it can be dispositioned, not
re-verified. Run `kb-code review lint` before composing.
